title: Tool Registry with Semver Resolution
signature: class ToolRegistry: register(name, version, status='active'), resolve(spec) -> dict
hints: Parse versions into integer tuples. Compare tuples, never the strings: '1.10.0' > '1.9.0' only as numbers.
Turn every range into a half-open interval [lower, upper). Pad the lower bound with zeros.
Caret bumps the leftmost non-zero part you were given (or the last given part if they are all zero). Tilde bumps the minor when a minor is given, else the major.
Filter by the interval first, then prefer active, then deprecated, then report removed or not_found.
